locked_on: Kaggle-test estimation pool only (17859 patients, 35718 eyes). Confirmation pool (8929 patients) not read by this notebook.

definitions.complementarity_C: C = 1 - m_both / min(m_A, m_B), severity-weighted, ceiling-normalised
definitions.weighted_dependence: rho_cost = Pearson correlation of per-case cost contributions
definitions.primary_aggregation: union rule at each model's own 25% threshold
definitions.secondary_aggregation: max-score aggregation at matched referral volume
definitions.seed_handling: all pair quantities averaged over the nine cross-seed combinations
definitions.algebraic_link: Within a sample, union advantage = min(m_A, m_B) x C. The predictor is one factor of the outcome; the test is out of sample, which is what makes it a test.

competing_rules.best_partner_marginal: minimise partner's own weighted miss cost (estimation)
competing_rules.random: uniform over the ten candidates, 1,000 draws
competing_rules.oracle: maximise the confirmation outcome; upper bound only

primary_endpoint.statistic: mean across 11 anchors of the within-anchor Spearman correlation between estimation-measured C and the confirmation outcome across that anchor 10 candidates
primary_endpoint.outcome_decision_basis: diagnostic 3 granularity thresholds pre-committed in section 13
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: bootstrap over architectures, 1000 resamples, anchors and candidate pools rebuilt from the resampled multiset, self-pairs excluded, repeated architectures contributing as distinct anchor instances
primary_endpoint.supported_if: point estimate positive and the 95 percent percentile interval excludes zero
primary_endpoint.also_reported: anchor permutation interval (not the decision rule: pairs recur across anchors so the eleven within-anchor correlations are not exchangeable); partial correlation controlling for estimation-measured partner marginal quality

decision_relevant_secondary: per-anchor paired difference in the confirmation outcome between least_ceiling_overlap and best_partner_marginal, architecture-bootstrapped

reliability_gate.if_passed: a null speaks to the mechanism
reliability_gate.if_failed: a null is a power statement and the implied sample size is reported

power_expectation.note: Recorded before the confirmation pool is opened so a null is pre-interpreted, not explained afterwards.
power_expectation.interpretation: Expected effect and detection threshold coincide. A null does not rule out a relationship of the size v3 implies; only a substantially stronger one registers.

named_limitation: The union primary is not volume-controlled. Holding each model to its own 25% means union volume varies only through overlap in the referred sets, so a low-overlap partner delivers both more complementarity and more referrals. The matched-volume max-score secondary separates them. A positive primary with a null secondary means selection works through volume, which is weaker than complementarity but still true, and is reported so.
exploratory_no_verdict: severity-weighted index as a consistency check against the count endpoint
max-score matched-volume results alongside the union rule
top-1 policy simulation in the v3 format for comparability
confirmation_status: CLOSED. Opened once, by the confirmation notebook, after this file exists.
